mods.name: Plants vs. Zombies Multiplayer
mods.summary: Online co-op for up to 4 players in Lawn Tycoon, a new endless mode where you walk the lawn as Crazy Dave, share the sun and money, and buy your way from one lane to five.
mods.description:
Plants vs. Zombies Multiplayer adds Lawn Tycoon, an endless co-op mode for up to 4 players. Every player walks around the lawn as their own Crazy Dave (each a different colour, with their name over his head) and plants on the tile they're standing on, and everyone shares the same sun and seed bank. You start in the front yard with one lane and only the Peashooter. Every zombie you kill pays out, the money is shared by the whole team, and the shop sells new seed types (39 plants, from Sunflower to Winter Melon), more lanes (up to all 5) and new lawn mowers. The waves never stop: every stage is 10 waves, and like the game's own Endless mode they get bigger and new kinds of zombies show up as you go. Host a Steam lobby and invite your friends (or they use "Join Game" on you, even while the game is running), or play over your home network by IP. Every plant, zombie, pea, sun drop and coin is the same for everyone. The rest of the game still works as normal, and your original install and saves aren't touched.

The zip contains an installer (PvZ-Multiplayer-Setup.exe) that finds your Plants vs. Zombies folder and sets Steam to start the mod, the raw mod files if you'd rather install it yourself, and a README explaining both. You need your own copy of Plants vs. Zombies (Game of the Year edition on Steam), and everyone needs the same version.
details: Up to 4 players, each walking the lawn as their own colour of Crazy Dave
Lawn Tycoon: start with 1 lane and the Peashooter, earn shared money from kills and buy seeds, lanes and mowers
Endless waves that scale up like the game's Endless mode
Shared sun, seed bank and money, and every plant, zombie and pea is synced
Join through Steam invites or "Join Game" (no port forwarding), even mid-game, or by IP on your home network
Installer exe + raw mod files + README in one zip
mods.changelog: 1.0.0: first public build. Up to 4 players, Lawn Tycoon endless co-op, Steam invites or LAN. Includes a one-click installer.

mods.name: SULFUR Multiplayer
mods.summary: Online co-op for 2–8 players, plus Sulf Arena: a competitive mode where up to 4 players build loadouts and fight each other. Join through Steam.
mods.description:
SULFUR Multiplayer lets you and your friends play SULFUR together. One player loads their save and hosts from the P menu, and everyone else joins through Steam (an invite, or "Join Game" in the friends list) — no IP addresses or port forwarding. Joiners drop straight into the host's level, level exits are a party vote (press Y to accept), and the whole party always lands in the same world. Enemies are run by the host's game, go after every player and scale with the number of players. Boss fights pull everyone into the arena, thrown grenades get a glowing trail and warning icon, molotov fire burns for everyone, and loot, chests, doors, breakables and loose physics objects are shared. The church stash and shops are shared, and you can drop ammo and money for teammates straight from your inventory. Other players show up as priests matching the first-person arms, holding whatever weapon they have out, and you see their bullets, reloads and crouching. A bar at the top of the screen shows everyone's ping and health and who joins or leaves. Everyone keeps their own character, inventory and save.

The zip contains an installer (SulfurMP-Setup.exe) that finds your SULFUR folder and sets everything up, the raw mod files if you'd rather install it yourself, and a README explaining both. Everyone needs the same version.

Sulf Arena is a competitive mode for up to 4 players, hosted from the main menu. Everyone gets 5000 to build a loadout in their own church (every vendor in the game is there with full stock, and the gun seller can level up your guns), then you're dropped into a small arena with no enemies and fight until one priest is left. The winner keeps their gear and gets +5000; everyone who died loses their gear and comes back with more money each round. First to 5 round wins is the champion. Sulf Arena doesn't use a save at all, so none of yours can change.
details: 2–8 players, joined through Steam invites or "Join Game" (no port forwarding)
Sulf Arena: competitive PvP for up to 4 players — buy a loadout, fight until one is left, first to 5 round wins
Enemy count scales with players (2 players = 2x enemies)
Shared enemies, boss fights, grenades, molotov fire, loot, chests, doors and physics objects
Shared church stash and shops, and drop ammo and money for teammates from your inventory
See and hear other players' gunfire, plus their reloads, crouching and grenades (with a trail and warning icon), and a top bar with ping and joins/leaves
Masks and armour shot off enemies, and scripted bosses like the Cousin, are synced for everyone
Level exits are a party vote, and everyone is brought into the boss arena when a fight starts
Installer exe + raw mod files + README in one zip
mods.changelog: 0.9.2: Sulf Arena fixes and additions — players who died no longer get stuck on the floor back in the church, the Repairman can repair your gear, the ammo crate is back, a robot vending box sells 5 random guns each round, the extra vendors stand by the church's own instead of crowding the spawn, and a scoreboard with Steam pictures sits in the top left. If your game crashes, rejoin and you keep your round wins and get round-based money for the next round. Everyone must update — 0.9.1 can't play with 0.9.2. 0.9.1: Sulf Arena no longer uses a save — host it straight from the main menu and friends join without picking one. The arena church is closed off like at the start of the game, every vendor brought into it now sells properly, and the gun seller can add a level to an equipped gun for 3000. Fixed players sometimes getting stuck when arriving in the church. 0.9.0: new Sulf Arena mode — host it from the main menu (P), up to 4 players. Build a loadout with 5000 in your own church with every vendor in the game, then fight the others in a small enemy-free arena until one is left; the winner keeps their gear and +5000, everyone else comes back with 10000, 15000 and so on. First to 5 round wins. Your save is never changed. Also fixed other players' bodies sinking into the floor on some levels. Everyone must update — 0.8.x can't play with 0.9.0. 0.8.2: other players' weapons and arms sit on the shoulders properly (remounted further forward and down). Compatible with 0.8.1 over the network, but update so everyone sees the same pose. 0.8.1: the multiplayer menu matches SULFUR's dark gold look, opens with P (a button in the top-right), and from the main menu Host opens your save list so you pick which character to host with — friends who Join Game also pick a save before connecting. Everyone must update. 0.8.0: enemy animations are synced, so players who aren't the host see enemies wind up their attacks before getting hit instead of them just standing there, enemies that died for the host always lie dead for everyone (including after you respawn or come back to a part of the level), spider webs cut by one player are gone for everyone, and other players' arms and weapon sit at their right shoulder instead of floating beside them. Everyone must update — 0.7.1 can't play with 0.8.0. 0.7.1: players who aren't the host now get attacked properly — enemies split their attention between all players instead of mostly going after the host, melee hits, explosions and poison reach them, more enemy swings connect, and arrows aim at them like they do at the host instead of flying over their heads. Everyone must update — 0.7.0 can't play with 0.7.1. 0.7.0: you hear other players' gunshots, masks, helmets and armour shot off enemies are gone for everyone, the Cousin boss now rises and fights for everyone (with its arms and the boss health bar) and a non-host walking into its pool wakes it, enemies that died for the host no longer stay alive (stuck in the floor and making noise) for other players, and players who aren't the host get hit through two routes, with immunity left over from a cutscene or safe zone repaired automatically. Everyone must update — 0.6.0 can't play with 0.7.0. 0.6.0: players who aren't the host now take damage from enemy bullets, level exits start a vote (Y to accept, N to decline, or walk into the exit too) instead of dragging everyone along, everyone is brought into the boss arena when someone starts the fight, molotov fire is synced, other players' grenades have a glowing trail and an on-screen warning icon, money can be dropped from the inventory like ammo, and the other players' priests are fully solid, have pale skin matching the first-person arms and hold their weapon out in front. Everyone must update — 0.5.0 can't play with 0.6.0. 0.5.0: enemies no longer shoot at the floor when aiming at other players, other players' guns are visible again (held by the first-person arms), you can see other players' bullets and reloads (with a RELOADING sign), crouching is synced, other players are now human priests that match the first-person arms, a new bar at the top of the screen shows players, ping, health and joins/leaves, and ammo is shared by dropping boxes from your inventory (click an ammo counter) instead of the G key. Everyone must update — 0.4.0 can't play with 0.5.0. 0.4.0: enemies scale with player count (2 players = 2x enemies), shared boss fights, synced hold-to-open doors and metal gates, thrown grenades show for everyone, shared church stash and shops, give ammo to a teammate with G, everyone always lands in the same world when someone takes an exit, and taller goblins with properly placed arms. Everyone must update — 0.3.0 can't play with 0.4.0.

mods.name: Noita Multiplayer
mods.summary: Two-player online co-op in one shared, fully synced Noita world. Join through Steam or by IP.
mods.description:
Noita Multiplayer puts you and a friend in the same world at the same time: terrain, liquids, fire, enemies, bosses, items, physics objects, spells, perks, orbs, hearts and gold are all synced. Pick "Co-op: Host" or "Co-op: Join" in the New Game menu, or invite your friend through Steam and their game loads your world by itself — even if they're sitting on the main menu. If you die while your partner is alive (even as a polymorphed creature) you go down instead, and they can revive you.

The zip contains an installer (NoitaCoop_Installer.exe) that sets everything up, the raw mod folders if you'd rather install it yourself, and a README explaining both. Both players need the same version.
details: Shared world: terrain, water, fire, enemies, bosses, items and physics props stay in sync
Join through Steam invites (no port forwarding), even from the main menu, or by direct IP
Downed & revive (polymorphed too), shared perks, orbs, hearts and gold
Installer exe + raw mod folders + README in one zip
mods.changelog: 1.5.0: fixed enemies moving along with the players, bosses stay in sync (the host runs the fight), breaking a Holy Mountain sends the guardian after both players, killed enemies no longer come back, perks no longer reappear after one is taken, no more doubled Holy Mountain spells, and gold is shared between both players. Both players must update (1.4.x can't connect to 1.5.0). 1.4.1: crash fixes, and a polymorphed partner shows up as the creature they turned into.

mods.name: FTL: Faster Than Light Multiplayer
mods.summary: Crew one ship together—online co-op for up to 8 players, each controlling one crew member. Join through Steam or by IP.
mods.description:
FTL Co-op puts up to 8 players on the same ship. Each player controls one crew member and runs the controls of the room they're standing in: the pilot handles power, jumps and the star map, the gunner aims and fires, and the doors, drones, teleporter, cloaking, hacking and mind control each belong to whoever mans that room. Crew nobody controls are run by a smarter AI that mans stations, repairs, fights fires and boarders and heads to the medbay when hurt. Invite a Steam friend from FTL's main menu (no port forwarding), or join by IP.

The zip contains an installer (FTL-Coop-Install.exe) that rolls FTL back to 1.6.9 and sets everything up, the raw mod files if you'd rather install it yourself, and a README explaining both. Everyone needs the same version.
details: Up to 8 players share one ship, one crew member each
Room-based controls: piloting, weapons, drones, doors and more
Join through Steam invites (no port forwarding) or by direct IP
Installer exe + raw mod files + README in one zip
mods.changelog: 11.0.0: first public build (co-op mod version 11). Up to 8 players, Steam invites or IP, join or leave mid-run, vote to save and quit, smarter AI crew for unclaimed crew members. Needs FTL 1.6.9 - the installer rolls it back for you.
